title: Girl Scouts Love State Parks 2026
details:
Date: Sat Sep 12, 10:00 AM EST - Sat Sep 12, 1:00 PM
GSSEF is hosting an in-person Girl Scouts Love State Parks Event at Von D. Mizell-Eula Johnson State Park.  This will include:

Activities: Service Project - Bag Our Park, Spanish Explorers Use of Sea Grapes, Beach Dune and Creek Walk, Sea Turtle Hatching activity.

What to bring, Refillable water bottle, work gloves, hat, sunscreen, insect repellent, sturdy closedtoe shoes/boots, and a packed lunch or plan to visit the concession stand.

Park admission will be waived for participants.

Girl Scouts Love State Parks patch included in program fee for all participants and will be mailed after the program date.

Questions? Contact customercare@gssef.org
